The sequel is coming in a fully destructible Voxel Open World!

notes.title: The Enchantments
notes.content:
*Features*

- Enchant System
- (Charpness, Protection, Growth and Mythic)
- Quick Slide (Roll while running)
- Key to open multiple areas and doors
- New NPC (the little witch)
- Minor difficulty balance
- lobby to test multiplayer (just for connecting)

*Fixed Bugs*
- Arrows and magic orbs were not affected by any armor with a damage boost, so yea that was lame
- The fire gloves were called the fire helemet, that was confusing xD
- The feather of gliding was'nt reset on a new character
- The gold was'nt reset to 0 on a new character

Thank you guys so much for the support / feed back :D
❤❤❤

notes.title: Content Update!
notes.content:
*Features*

- New Class (Archer)
- Possible to create multiple characters
- Dash (Roll while running)
- New default skin (to fit the archer)
- 12 new items (equipements / armor)
- 2 secrets areas
- A new secret NPC (red trader)
- Minor difficulty balance
- 2rd person camera (Press f5)

*Fixed bugs*

- Falling in the void
- Getting stuck in the pillards
- The Old Book dealing 0 damage
- Knockback not working
- Ground pound on the enemys head abuse
- Could'nt access the last levels without the feather
- Could buy and craft an infinite amount of potions
- The coins and the items were blocking projectiles
- The 100 and 500 gold acheivements were impossible to complete

Thank you guys so much for the support and feed back :D
❤❤❤
